# rhcs_nodepool_seaplane (Resource)

Manages NodePool resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UID of the parent cluster; validated against cluster_name.
- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the parent cluster; must match the NodePool name prefix.
- `name` (String) Client-selected NodePool name in <cluster>.<child> form.

### Optional

- `additional_security_group_ids` (Attributes List) Additional AWS security group IDs to attach to node pool instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_security_group_ids))
- `ami` (String) Ami.
- `auto_repair` (Boolean) AutoRepair.
- `autoscaling` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `capacity_reservation_id` (String) CapacityReservationId.
- `capacity_reservation_market_type` (String) CapacityReservationMarketType.
- `config` (Attributes List) ConfigMap references containing serialized nodepool configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `disk_size` (Number) DiskSize.
- `ec2_instance_metadata_http_tokens` (String) EC2 instance metadata HTTP token requirement. `required` enforces IMDSv2; `optional` permits IMDSv1. Defaults to `required` and is immutable after creation.
- `filters` (String) Filters.
- `image` (String) Image.
- `image_type` (String) Operating system image family for the nodes in this pool, either `Linux` (RHCOS, the default when unset) or `Windows`. Windows pools are License Included: the hourly instance cost covers both the Windows Server OS and the Red Hat support subscription. This is baked into every instance the pool launches, so changing it replaces the node pool; add Windows capacity to an existing cluster with a second node pool.
- `instance_profile` (String) InstanceProfile.
- `instance_type` (String) InstanceType.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `max_price` (String) MaxPrice.
- `max_surge` (String) Largest number of nodes that can be added to this pool during an upgrade, as an absolute node count (for example `2`). Defaults to 0 when unset: nodes are replaced in-place. The Platform API also accepts a percentage, which this provider cannot send yet.
- `max_unavailable` (String) Largest number of nodes in this pool that may be unavailable at the same time while the pool is upgrading, as an absolute node count (for example `2`). It may not exceed `replicas`. Defaults to 0 when unset: no node is taken out of service until its replacement is ready. The Platform API also accepts a percentage, which this provider cannot send yet.
- `node_drain_grace_period` (String) Grace period before a node is forcibly drained during upgrade or replacement, as a Go duration string (for example `5m` for 5 minutes, `1h` for 1 hour). Defaults to `0s` when unset: the node is drained indefinitely. Increase this to prevent a misbehaving workload from blocking node replacement indefinitely.
- `node_labels` (Map of String) NodeLabels.
- `node_volume_detach_timeout` (String) NodeVolumeDetachTimeout.
- `placement_market_type` (String) PlacementMarketType.
- `preference` (String) Preference.
- `replicas` (Number) Replicas.
- `subnet_id` (String) SubnetId.
- `tags` (Map of String) Customer AWS tags applied to resources for this NodePool. They combine with Cluster tags and use the shared AWS tag budget after reserved system tags.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Node taints applied to nodes in this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))
- `tenancy` (String) Tenancy.
- `tuning_config` (Attributes List) ConfigMap references containing tuning configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tuning_config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id.
- `phase` (String) Current lifecycle phase of the node pool (Provisioning, Ready, Deleting).
- `platform_type` (String) Platform type for the NodePool (AWS).
